plainTranslation: A's love and values meets B's dreams. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with your imagination, hope, and idealism. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The difficulty is that both people can become comfortable living in potential. Feelings are sensed rather than spoken. Hopes are assumed rather than discussed. You may believe you are on the same page without ever checking whether that is actually true.
advice:
Over time, what remains unsaid matters.

This aspect works best when you allow the magic to coexist with clarity.
